selected_candidate.name: cache the BF16 SDPA denominator exponent for normalization
selected_candidate.mechanism: During the denominator pass, compute exp(score - row_max) once, store that f32 value back to s_stream, and add the same value to the existing per-lane sum. During normalization, multiply the cached f32 value by normalizer instead of evaluating exp a second time.
selected_candidate.why_this_candidate: It removes one exp per key from SdpaDecodeNativeBF16, the only kernel with a positive 11.0815 ms/token long-context GPU-busy delta, while retaining the qualified 1024-thread workgroup and the existing dispatch, reduction, and output accumulation shapes.
selected_candidate.numerical_risk: The proposal is acceptable only if storing and reloading the first exp result is word-identical to the current second exp evaluation for every tested score. Any mismatch rejects the candidate; no tolerance-based fallback is allowed.

protocol.remote_stage_check: The exact payload and workload hashes are checked inside the same remote command immediately before setsid exec.
protocol.guardian: setsid --wait timeout owns one remote process group; the payload records the exact timeout guardian and process group.
protocol.final_clearance: The payload detects and terminates owned residual descendants before release. In-payload and independent post-run scans then require guardian absence, an empty process group, no staged workload process, no lease, and a free lock.
